name: Step 3 — Predatory Short (SPXU)
description: Confirmed by the client directly. Activates ONLY when Step 2 is in CASH: puts a slice of the idle cash into SPXU (3x inverse S&P 500) when SPY is below its 200-day average and VIX spikes above the entry threshold. KNOWN FLAW: the exit rule tends to sell this hedge once the market has already calmed down -- close to the worst time to sell insurance. This is a confirmed strategy design flaw, not a bug, and has not been fixed -- it is shown here as-is so the effect is visible in the numbers.
signal_source: SPY + VIX (during Step 2 CASH periods only)

allocations.CASH_IDLE: 0% SPXU (Step 2 in CASH, entry conditions not met)
allocations.INACTIVE: Step 2 not in CASH -- this overlay does nothing

known_flaw: Sells the hedge when VIX calms down or SPY reclaims its 50-SMA -- i.e. near the point the hedge is worth the least. Confirmed strategy flaw, not fixed.
